bio.text: Raymond Smith Jr. is the Democratic nominee for North Carolina's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the March 3 primary.
He represented District 21 in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023 and served on the Wayne County Public Schools board from 2016 to 2019.

He was born in Goldsboro, served in the U.S. Army, and holds degrees from North Carolina A&T State University (1992), North Carolina Central University (1998) and a Ph.D. from Fayetteville State University (2020).
